user.title: Connect your Family Hub
user.description: Frostbox talks to the fridge through SmartThings. The easiest way is to reuse Home Assistant's built-in SmartThings integration (set that up first). A personal access token works for testing but Samsung expires those after 24 hours.

pat.title: Personal access token
pat.description: Create one at https://account.smartthings.com/tokens with all Devices and Locations scopes.

error.no_fridge: No refrigerator was found on this SmartThings account.

abort.core_missing: Set up Home Assistant's SmartThings integration first (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → SmartThings), then add Frostbox.
abort.already_configured: This fridge is already set up.
abort.no_fridge: No refrigerator was found on this SmartThings account. Finish the fridge's SmartThings setup first.
abort.reauth_core: Re-authenticate the SmartThings integration; Frostbox uses its login.

data.fridge_screen_switches: Add Frostbox switches to the fridge screen

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll SmartThings. Door changes arrive faster when the core SmartThings integration is installed.
data_description.shopping_list_entity: Low staples and filters get added here. Sync it to Apple Reminders with any to-do integration.
data_description.camera_sources: Existing cameras that receive Family Hub photos (for example from a Family Hub camera integration). Each becomes a Frostbox camera you can expose to Apple Home.
data_description.view_inside_url_template: Advanced: download AI Vision Inside photos directly. Placeholders: {file_id}, {device_id}, {focus_area}.
data_description.view_inside_token: Bearer token for the URL above. Leave empty to use the SmartThings token.
data_description.fridge_screen_switches: Creates SmartThings virtual switches (Party, Grocery, Vacation, Dinner ready) that you can tap on the Family Hub or ask Bixby to turn on.
data_description.party_flexzone_mode: Raw SmartThings mode, e.g. CV_FDR_BEVERAGE. Leave empty to auto-pick a beverage mode.
data_description.recipe_conversation_agent: Optional. Without one, recipes come from TheMealDB.
